Episode 1 — The Watch Shop

Yaar... aaj main tujhe ek kahani sunata hoon.

Ek aise ladke ki, jiski duniya mein bahut saari awaazein hain... lekin woh unmein se aadhi awaazein hi sun sakta hai.

Kahani shuru hoti hai ek purani watch shop se. Subah ka waqt hai, aur shop ke andar har taraf purani ghadiyan lagi hui hain...

Har ghadi tik-tik kar rahi hai. Ek saath itni saari awaazein hain... lekin phir bhi, wahan ek ajeeb si khamoshi hai.

Usi shop mein, workbench ke peeche ek chhote se cot par, Zayn so raha hai.

Dheere-dheere uski aankhein khulti hain. Woh uthta hai aur apne aas-paas ki ghadiyon ko sunne ki koshish karta hai... lekin woh sab kuch nahi sun sakta.

Uska left ear do saal pehle hi kaam karna band kar chuka tha... aur ab uske right ear ki sunne ki taaqat bhi dheere-dheere kam ho rahi hai.

Soch na yaar, jab tere aas-paas poori duniya awaazein kar rahi ho... lekin tujhe unmein se aadhi hi sunai dein. Toh kaisa lagega?

Phir Zayn ki nazar apne dadaji ki purani pocket watch par padti hai. Woh use apne haath mein uthata hai...

Ghadi ki sui 6 bajkar 40 minute par ruki hui hai. Aur ajeeb baat ye hai ki Zayn use theek nahi karta.

Woh bas ghadi ko wind karta hai... aur phir use waapas rakh deta hai. Jaise us ghadi ko apne paas rakhna hi uske liye kaafi ho.

Tabhi shop ka bell bajta hai. Koi shop ke andar aaya hai... lekin Zayn ko bell ki awaaz sunai hi nahi deti.

Aur yahin par kahani humein ek line deti hai... Half a world is still a world.

Matlab, duniya ka aadha hissa bhi ek poori duniya ho sakta hai. Zayn ki duniya doosron se alag hai... lekin woh bhi ek duniya hai. Uski apni duniya.

Aur yaar, shayad isi baat ko samajhna is kahani ka sabse khoobsurat hissa hai.

Ye bas ek aise ladke ki kahani hai, jo kuch awaazein nahi sun sakta... lekin uski kahani abhi shuru hui hai.

Aur mujhe lagta hai, humein abhi Zayn ke baare mein bahut kuch jaan-na baaki hai.
